intro: Sleek, modern, and light in feel—Atlas makes every meal feel fresh. Its transparent top and open frame bring clarity and comfort into your dining space.

features.title: Crystal-clear glass top
features.text: The 10 mm tempered glass surface adds elegance and depth while being strong, easy to clean, and resistant to daily wear and tear.

features.title: Chrome-plated MS frame
features.text: With its polished, chrome-plated MS pipe base, Atlas offers both shine and strength, perfectly balancing minimal design with solid support.

features.title: Effortlessly modern look
features.text: Designed for lovers of clean lines and open spaces, Atlas enhances modern homes with its airy structure and minimalist appeal.

features.title: Secure UV disc mounting
features.text: The glass top is secured using UV discs, ensuring a firm, discreet hold while maintaining the clean aesthetic and stability you need.

features.title: Spacious, open legroom
features.text: Its base design creates ample space under the table, so everyone sits comfortably without bumping into legs or supports.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Atlas 6-Seater Glass Rectangular Dining Table
